contract_name: Accenture LLM vs Non-LLM Processing Classification Standard
core_principle: The LLM is NEVER the source of quantitative truth. All mathematical, statistical, validation, data quality, and safety gates are 100% deterministic (Non-LLM).

pipeline_stages.responsibility: Computes rolling 3-month baseline mean, variance %, and materiality threshold gate.
Extracts operational telemetry across 5 domains and scores initial candidate fit.
Reconciles sales, marketing, inventory, and pricing records on (date, market, product_code).
Validates schema integrity, null rates, duplicates, and 36-month temporal completeness.

pipeline_stages.engine: Deterministic Scorer + LLM Natural Language Synthesizer
pipeline_stages.responsibility: Scores competing drivers and synthesizes claim-grounded explanatory narrative.
Validates zero hallucination, scope boundaries, citation integrity, and uncertainty consistency.
Applies bounded arithmetic adjustments to future driver prioritization without modifying evidence.
Adapts tone, decision emphasis, and detail level for Executive vs Domain Analyst personas.
